description: This file defines an enum 'SystemPresenceInfo' with static methods to retrieve system presence information such as the time since the last input event and the primary IPv4 address.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds since the last user input event, or nil if the value is invalid or not available.

methods.name: primaryIPv4Address
methods.description: Returns the primary IPv4 address of the system as a string, or nil if not available.
